Parking: This property provides a large private driveway with at least four parking spots, giving guests plenty of space for multiple vehicles and ensuring easy, hassle free access throughout their stay.

Experience Your Vacation Haven!

Welcome to your private Gulf-front retreat on Scenic 30A—where sweeping shoreline views, unmatched sunsets, and pure coastal serenity come together to create the ultimate beach getaway. Nestled on an oversized, estate-style lot, this charming beachfront cottage offers rare privacy thanks to lush tropical landscaping, elevated Gulf vistas, and generous outdoor space. With a long circular driveway providing ample parking for multiple vehicles, arrival is effortless and peaceful from the moment you pull in.

Step inside and be greeted by an expansive great room framed by floor-to-ceiling Gulf views that instantly set the tone for an unforgettable stay. The home’s signature feature—an extra-wide Gulf-front deck spanning the entire length of the cottage—invites you to relax, dine, or lounge while overlooking the emerald waters and sugar-white sand below. Elevated 26 feet above the beach, the vantage point delivers panoramic coastline views and nightly sunsets that feel close enough to touch.

The Gulf-front primary suite features a plush king bed, stunning water views, and direct access to the deck—perfect for waking up to soft morning light dancing across the waves. Two spacious guest bedrooms each offer two queen beds, providing comfortable accommodations for families or groups. Both bathrooms include exterior doors with outside showers for easy beach access, making it simple to rinse off sandy toes after a day in the sun.

With direct, private beach access just steps from the deck, your days can be spent swimming, strolling the shoreline, or simply soaking up the coastal breeze. Afterward, unwind in the cozy interiors designed for laid-back living, or enjoy the shade and serenity of the beautifully landscaped grounds surrounding the home. The home has a garage with ping pong table for extra fun and a BBQ grill to cook up the catch of the day!

Located on the highly coveted west end of 30A, this property places you within walking distance of Gulf Place, where you'll find local dining, boutique shopping, live music, and vibrant community events. Despite its convenient location, the deep lot and natural landscape create a peaceful, secluded environment rarely found along Scenic 30A.

Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or the perfect backdrop for unforgettable memories, this gulf-front cottage offers a blend of simplicity, comfort, and breathtaking beauty—making it a truly exceptional vacation retreat on Florida’s Emerald Coast.

About the Community of Dune Allen on 30A
Nestled on scenic highway 30A is the charming community Dune Allen Beach. A longstanding local spot for eclectic shops, eateries and homes, this part of 30A is often sought after for a laid back beach lifestyle. Its restaurants and stores are locally owned and at the heart of the community’s vibe. The 30A bike path will offer a safe, dedicated option to check it all out. Within a short loop you can grab coffee at nearby Gulf Place or stop by the bakery by heading back east to Blue Mountain Beach. Enjoy days on the beach and biking through blue lupine, the area’s native blue flowering plant. When you’re ready for more adventure, seek out the numerous biking and hiking trails that twist and turn through the surrounding Point Washington State Forest. Amenities such as golf, tennis, biking, boating, water sports and more are available locally at additional costs.
